main() CLI: block = read_model_block(security_key(args.security)) where render_pack.security_key(security) = security.replace(' ', '_').replace('/', '-') (:148; its own docstring says it is for LOCAL FILESYSTEM names only, never an S3 key). The read therefore lists derived/model_block/BP-_LN_Equity/, a form that exists nowhere. Exercise (live, read-only): security_key('BP/_LN_Equity') -> 'BP-_LN_Equity' -> read_model_block -> None; security_key('BP/ LN Equity') -> 'BP-_LN_Equity' -> None; NG likewise 'NG-_LN_Equity' -> None. The CLI prints 'BLOCKED: no landed model block for <name>' and returns 1. Contrast: every non-slash name maps identically (space to _ equals the key form), e.g. 'SAP GY Equity' -> 'SAP_GY_Equity'. Reachability: git grep of render_pack over lib/ integrations/ infra/ (tests excluded) finds no caller of main(); the served print route (scoped_amgt.py:4480) does not use it. No served surface shows this ABSENT.

load_model_block reads a repo/local file os.path.join(model_block_dir or MODEL_BLOCK_DIR, 'model_block_%s.json' % security_key); it never touches s3://opal-data-harvest/derived/model_block/. It is not a reader of the store, listed because it shares the model_block name; with a raw slash key the path would nest a directory, but this reader is outside the store the writer defect concerns. No S3 exercise applies.
